steps.instruction:
Add beef to pot and sear until it's golden on all sides.
Remove and set aside.

Add shallots and garlic to pot.
Cook 10 minutes, or until soften and golden.

Add all ingredients to pot.
Gently stir until hot and thicken.

Return beef to pot.
Cook on low heat in pressure cooker for 15 minutes.
Release the pressure, open the lid and leave the beef to rest for 10 minutes.
Beef should flake apart easily with 2 forks.

title: Beef Ragu
ingredients:
500 g chuck beef
(season with salt and pepper)

0.5 g dried thyme
(or 1 sprig fresh thyme)

steps.instruction:
Add beef to pot and sear until it's golden on all sides.
Remove and set aside.

Add garlic and onion to the pot and sauté for 2 minutes.
Add carrots and celery and sauté for 5 minutes.

Add the remaining ragu ingredients to the pot.
Return the beef to the pot.
Cook in the pressure cooker for 40 minutes.

Remove the beef and shred with two forks.
Return the shredded beef to the pot.
Simmer for 10 minutes, or until the sauce has thickened.

title: Beef Stew with Potatoes
ingredients:
1.3 kg beef chuck roast
(cut into 3 cm chunks)

steps.instruction:
Add beef to pot, pour over 2l of boiling water.
Gently boil for 10 minutes.
Skim and discard the foam until the broth is clear.
Prepare the ginger and onion.
Wash and cut carrots and potatoes.

Add the ingredients.
Cook in pressure cooker for 35 minute

Add the carrots and potatoes.
Cook in pressure cooker for 5 minutes
until the vegetables are tender.

title: BBQ Ribs
ingredients:
1.8 kg pork spareribs
(cut into serving portions)

steps.instruction:
Cut ribs and wrap in tin foil.
Bake at 180°C for 1.5 hours.

Peel and crush the garlic.
Mix the ingredients in a bowl.
Marinate for 1 hour at room temperature, or refrigerate for 8–24 hours.

Grill at 200°C for 30 minutes, turning occasionally and basting frequently.
Remove once the ribs are caramelised and lightly charred.

Preheat oven to 180°C (step 1) 
Preheat oven to 200°C (step 3)

title: Lemon Bars
ingredients:
66 g powdered sugar
(for shortbread,
+ more for dusting)

steps.instruction: Whisk the dry ingredients.
Melt the butter.

Add the lemon zest and sugar to a food processor.
Pulse until the zest is fully incorporated and the sugar is a light yellow color.
Juice and zest the lemons.

Pour the melted butter and vanilla into the dry ingredients.
Mix until combined.
Mix the lemon zest, sugar, and flour.

Sprinkle the dough into the lined pan and press down into a flat layer.
Bake at 170°C for about 15 minutes, or until lightly golden.
Mix very well until fully combined.

Pour the filling onto the warm crust.
Bake at 170°C for about 25 minutes, rotating the pan halfway through.
Remove from the oven and cool for 1 hour, then refrigerate for 2 hours.
Dust with powdered sugar and cut into bars using a clean, sharp, damp knife.
Clean and re-wet the knife after each cut.

Heat oven to 170°C.
